tool_args.rationale: The dual-horizon model narrowly misses the fresh-confirmation tolerance. Since the data are not visibly non-stationary, acquire the trajectory batch to help distinguish a revised horizon-response fit from the coupled memory alternative before confirming a model.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The fresh confirmation RMSE of 0.046682 exceeds the 0.045 tolerance, so the current confirmation does not support submitting this model unchanged.
The existing rows vary H and u_now but hold x_now and mem_conv at zero; a trajectory batch is more informative for testing this alternative.
The observed sign reversal is smooth and consistent with stationary mechanisms; there is no evidence of chaotic oscillation or that all stationary models fail.
It does not resolve the model discrepancy and is explicitly an irrelevant, high-cost measurement.
